item.content:encoded: I actually didn't notice the italics until you pointed them out! Though that's primarily the font's fault.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
It should be an inability, yes.

The italics are supposed to represent that the Investor is making noises. I suppose parentheses could be more obvious, but I prefer italics as the visual cue. In any case, the Factory — who is making the document — is treating those noises as actual speech, so they aren't going to mark it with parentheses or brackets.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Mr. Night remains unable to sign, citing an ability

Is this supposed to be "inability?"

If my understanding is correct, The Investor is making noises, not saying "A thousand clicks and a groan." Shouldn't there be parenthesis for his dialogue(?) so this is better apparent?

item.title: Black As Night - Part 4
item.content:encoded:
This is the next installment in Black as Night, and the beginning of Act 2 (Chicago Spectre). This is a series detailing the life and times of Mr. Night, the true founder of the Chicago Spirit. Act 1 was about the fall of the Chicago Spirit, and Act 2 will detail the rise of the Chicago Spectre.

Thanks to my reviewers: tretter, DrChandra, rounderhouse, and Pratten.
